title: 考研主题练习 02 · 社会变化与公共生活
description: 原创缩编练习，学习情境为虚构，覆盖非听力题型。参考考研英语二的医疗、城市和公共资源章节，全文为原创缩编内容。

sections.title: 写作
sections.instructions: 按题目要求完成写作。提交后查看参考范文，自行核对。
study_paragraphs: Public services should be evaluated by accessibility as well as efficiency. A service may process applications quickly, but it cannot be successful if older people, people with disabilities or residents without stable internet cannot use it. Governments can measure waiting times while also testing forms with different users and offering several channels. These steps may require more staff at first, but they can prevent repeated applications and reduce hidden costs. Efficient systems save resources. Accessible systems make sure those resources benefit people fairly. Good public administration needs both qualities.

sections.title: 选词填空
sections.instructions: 从词库选词，每词只用一次。
paragraphs: A health system may improve when it moves care closer to people’s homes. Local clinics can [1] ______ minor problems from becoming emergencies and [2] ______ patients with specialists when necessary. However, a reform should not simply [3] ______ work without staff and equipment. Policymakers need to [4] ______ results and listen to patients. Otherwise, an efficient change may [5] ______ new delays elsewhere.
study_paragraphs: A health system may improve when it moves care closer to people’s homes. Local clinics can prevent minor problems from becoming emergencies and connect patients with specialists when necessary. However, a reform should not simply transfer work without staff and equipment. Policymakers need to monitor results and listen to patients. Otherwise, an efficient change may create new delays elsewhere.

questions.explanation: 第 1 空填入 prevent，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 2 空填入 connect，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 3 空填入 transfer，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 4 空填入 monitor，结合上下文和句法关系判断。
第 5 空填入 create，结合上下文和句法关系判断。

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The queue that moved elsewhere
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A hospital introduced online booking and celebrated a shorter telephone queue. Patients unable to use the tool arrived in person, crowding reception. The hospital trained volunteers, kept a small telephone service and explained appointment allocation. It stopped treating a shorter phone queue as the only sign of success: a queue may disappear from one place while growing in another.

sections.title: 阅读理解 · The cost of a quiet street
sections.instructions: 阅读短文，选择最合适的答案。
paragraphs: A town planned to close a central street to cars on weekends. Shop owners worried about deliveries and parents wanted safety. A six-week trial allowed deliveries before noon and collected reports. Pedestrian numbers rose, but a side street became crowded. The council adjusted signs and continued the closure with a delivery window.

sections.title: 翻译 · 中译英
sections.instructions: 完成翻译，提交后查看参考译文。
paragraphs: 随着人口老龄化，许多社区开始重新思考公共服务的安排。除了提供医疗和照护，社区还需要建设方便步行的道路、可以交流的公共空间以及帮助老年人使用数字服务的支持网络。
study_paragraphs: As the population ages, many communities are reconsidering how public services should be arranged. In addition to medical care and support, communities need walkable streets, public spaces for interaction and networks that help older people use digital services.

questions.answer: As the population ages, many communities are reconsidering how public services should be arranged. In addition to medical care and support, communities need walkable streets, public spaces for interaction and networks that help older people use digital services.
